basic_details.job_title: IIT (ISM) Dhanbad Project Associate I (Electrical Engineering) Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Electrical Engineering at IIT (ISM) Dhanbad has invited applications for one Project Associate-I position in the ISRO RESPOND sponsored project "GaN based high frequency programmable CC-CV dc-dc converter". The tenure is a maximum of 18 months or till the end of the project, whichever is earlier, with a fellowship of 31,000/- + 20% HRA per month. The essential qualification is an M.Tech. / M.E. degree in Power Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a closely related specialisation. qualification.details: Prior experience in PCB design: hands-on experience with PCB design software tools for schematic capture, multi-layer layout routing, and SMD soldering/rework. Basic knowledge of power electronics: strong foundational understanding of power electronic converters, high-frequency switching topologies, and operational principles. Embedded system programming: proficiency in C/C++ coding for developing digital control algorithms.

how_to_apply: Applications are to be made through the Google form at https://forms.gle/2pKwBYJQmnDJGKWGA by 5 December 2026, 5:00 PM. The notice asks candidates to combine attested marksheets and degree certificates into a single PDF. It also prints the subject line "Application for Project Associate-I for Project No. SRDP 1423 G" and the email address [email protected].

faq.question: Q1. How many Project Associate-I posts are vacant at IIT (ISM) Dhanbad?
faq.answer: The notice announces one (01) Project Associate-I position in the ISRO RESPOND project, Project No. SRDP 1423 G.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The deadline is 5 December 2026, 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for Project Associate-I?
faq.answer: The essential qualification is an M.Tech. / M.E. degree in Power Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a closely related specialisation.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 35 years as on the closing date of the application. Relaxation for SC/ST/OBC/PwD/Female candidates applies as per Government of India rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the fellowship for this post?
faq.answer: The fellowship is 31,000/- + 20% HRA per month.

faq.question: Q6. Is HRA paid on top of the fellowship?
faq.answer: Yes. The notice states the fellowship as 31,000/- + 20% HRA per month.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Apply through the Google form at https://forms.gle/2pKwBYJQmnDJGKWGA, with attested marksheets and degree certificates combined into a single PDF.

faq.question: Q8. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: Candidates are shortlisted and then interviewed online. The notice says the minimum qualification alone does not guarantee an interview invitation.

faq.question: Q9. For how long is the project post?
faq.answer: The tenure of the project is a maximum of 18 months or till the end of the project, whichever is earlier.

faq.question: Q10. What work will the Project Associate-I do?
faq.answer: The work includes simulation modelling, high-frequency GaN converter hardware design, PCB layout and assembly, component sourcing, experimental testing and debugging, data compilation, analysis, and report preparation.
